title: When the World Is the Test Suite: Agentic Intelligence for the Physical World
abstract: arXiv:2611.22291v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Coding agents built to repair software now write, test, and repair programs for robots, laboratories, and industrial controllers. Unlike in software engineering, no test suite comes with the code. Whether a program works must be established by running it on a robot, in a physics simulator, or through the policies it helps to train, and such evidence is costly to obtain and can itself be wrong. As these agents take on more physical tasks, how their programs are judged matters as much as how they are written. This paper examines this emerging area, agentic intelligence for the physical world, by treating the world as the program's test suite. We organize the discussion around three questions: how agents write programs for the physical world, how these programs are tested, and how agents learn from the results. We first trace how language models for robots and software engineering agents came together, ask which software testing practices

translated_title: 当世界成为测试套件：面向物理世界的智能体智能
translated_abstract: 为修复软件而构建的编程智能体，如今开始为机器人、实验室和工业控制器编写、测试和修复程序。与软件工程不同，这些代码并不附带现成的测试套件。程序是否有效，必须通过在真实机器人上运行、在物理模拟器中执行、或通过它所辅助训练的策略来验证，而这类验证证据获取成本高昂，且本身也可能是错误的。随着这些智能体承担越来越多的物理任务，程序的评判方式与其编写方式变得同等重要。本文通过将物理世界视为程序的测试套件，考察了这一新兴领域——面向物理世界的智能体智能。我们围绕三个问题组织讨论：智能体如何为物理世界编写程序、这些程序如何被测试、以及智能体如何从测试结果中学习。我们首先追溯了面向机器人的语言模型与软件工程智能体如何走向融合，并探讨哪些软件测试实践可以……
tldr: 本文提出将物理世界视为程序的测试套件，系统考察了面向物理世界的智能体智能这一新兴领域，围绕智能体如何为物理世界编写程序、如何测试这些程序以及如何从测试结果中学习三个核心问题展开论述。
en_tdlr: This paper frames the physical world itself as the program's test suite and surveys the emerging field of agentic intelligence for the physical world, organized around three core questions: how agents write programs for the physical world, how those programs are tested, and how agents learn from the results.
